prose: Dean McDonnell performs astonishing one-man-band style psychedelic music under the name LuSiD. Blending electronic sounds with several analogue instruments, a LuSiD show is an unforgettable, mind blowing thing. Tune in to hear about what makes Dean McDonnell tick, get familiar with some of his musical personas, and explore the deep flow state of live-looping instruments.
